New Tourism and Civic Projects Launched Around India's Statue of Unity

Expansion at Ekta Nagar

Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched and inaugurated a package of development projects totaling over Rs 426 crore in Ekta Nagar, Gujarat, according to reports from the Press Trust of India. The initiative is designed to upgrade tourism facilities, civic infrastructure, and connectivity around the Statue of Unity, which serves as a prominent regional tourism hub.

According to official reports, the newly unveiled package includes the inauguration of 23 completed projects valued at approximately Rs 307.83 crore, alongside the foundation stone laying for eight upcoming projects worth Rs 118.88 crore.

Newly Inaugurated Attractions and Infrastructure

The developments span multiple sectors, encompassing hospitality, ecological exhibits, and municipal infrastructure. Confirmed highlights from the inauguration include:

  • Tourism and Hospitality: A new hotel built by the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) at a cost of Rs 50 crore, the Ekta Cruise priced at Rs 16 crore, a Rain Forest attraction, and an Eco-Trail.
  • Civic and Transport Upgrades: Installation of travelators valued at Rs 28.22 crore, new colony roads and staff quarters, water and sewage treatment plants, and the introduction of air-conditioned electric buses.
  • Visual and Lighting Enhancements: Upgrades to the Unity Glow Garden, exterior campus lighting, and the 'Ekta Prakash Parv' heritage display.

Upcoming projects under the foundation-laying phase include the Gora-Bhanadra Road, a Smart Zero Waste integrated facility, the Khalwani Bridge, and new botanical gardens featuring cacti and butterflies.

Practical Visitor Guidance and Considerations

For travelers planning a visit to Ekta Nagar in the Gujarat region, certain practical factors apply regardless of new infrastructure announcements:

  • Seasonal Planning: Travelers should review local weather patterns before visiting, as regional temperatures can fluctuate significantly depending on the time of year.
  • Transport Context: While local connectivity is being enhanced via new roads, pedestrian pathways, and electric buses, visitors should verify current local transit schedules and traffic advisories prior to arrival.
  • Official Verification: Because tourism offerings, entry rules, and facility operational hours are subject to change, prospective visitors should consult official government tourism portals or advisory channels for up-to-date and confirmed guidance before finalizing travel plans.

*Note: This overview is based on reported government announcements. Travelers are advised that entry requirements and facility availability are subject to official verification.*
